related.title: Fugaku A64FX：SVE 尾端遮罩與向量長度
related.titleEn: Fugaku A64FX: SVE tails and vector length
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付矩陣索引、FMA/FLOP定義與大小擴展表；524288與4194304一致，報告明示2n³是主項近似且輸出全覆蓋；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver matrix indices, FMA/FLOP definitions and size-scaling tables. Verify both counts, identify 2 n³ as leading approximation, and cover every output. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 列每回合起點0、8、16…96及尾端4個有效lane；再畫4-lane分割；13與25正確，所有尾端有效索引被寫一次、哨兵未修改。
related.differenceEn: List starts 0, 8, 16…96 with four valid tail lanes, then construct four-lane partitions. Verify 13 and 25, each valid index written once and sentinels unchanged.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: n×n矩陣乘法採每乘加2 FLOP的慣例，主項F=2n³；這是運算計數而非硬體發射數；合成n=64與128，忽略末項差異，固定雙精度與同一算法；名義式 2*64**3 = 524288 FLOP；變更式 2*128**3 = 4194304 FLOP。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

FP64每元素64位元，L=VL/64；執行回合為ceil(N/L)，最後回合遮掉超出N的lane；合成N=100，教學VL512位元；對照VL256是可攜模型，並非更改Fugaku硬體；名義式 ceil(100/(512/64)) = 13 vector iterations；變更式 ceil(100/(256/64)) = 25 vector iterations。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Square matrix multiplication uses leading count F=2 n³ when multiply-add counts as 2 FLOP; this differs from issued instructions. Synthetic n=64 versus 128, using leading-term counts with fixed FP64 and algorithm. Nominal 2*64**3 = 524288 FLOP; changed 2*128**3 = 4194304 FLOP. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

FP64 lanes are L=VL/64; iterations are ceil(N/L), with out-of-range tail lanes masked. N = 100, VL = 512 bits; VL = 256 is a portability model, not a claim that Fugaku hardware is reconfigured. Nominal ceil(100/(512/64)) = 13 vector iterations; changed ceil(100/(256/64)) = 25 vector iterations. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Intel AVX-512：遮罩向量與頻率取捨
related.titleEn: Intel AVX-512: masked vectors and frequency tradeoffs
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付矩陣索引、FMA/FLOP定義與大小擴展表；524288與4194304一致，報告明示2n³是主項近似且輸出全覆蓋；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver matrix indices, FMA/FLOP definitions and size-scaling tables. Verify both counts, identify 2 n³ as leading approximation, and cover every output. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 標指令寬度、有效lane、FMA慣例及時鐘來源；另保留四lane對照而不混入本式；48/38.4正確且標理想值，部署前核對所需ISA與作業系統支援。
related.differenceEn: Label width, active lanes, FMA convention and clock source; retain a separate four-lane comparison. Verify 48/38.4 as ideal values and check required ISA/OS support before deployment.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: n×n矩陣乘法採每乘加2 FLOP的慣例，主項F=2n³；這是運算計數而非硬體發射數；合成n=64與128，忽略末項差異，固定雙精度與同一算法；名義式 2*64**3 = 524288 FLOP；變更式 2*128**3 = 4194304 FLOP。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
簡化吞吐R=lane×每laneFLOP×每週期向量數×GHz；只作理想算術上限；FP64八lane、FMA每lane2FLOP、每週期1向量；有效3.0GHz對2.4GHz；名義式 8*2*1*3 = 48 GFLOP/s/core ideal；變更式 8*2*1*2.4 = 38.4 GFLOP/s/core ideal。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Square matrix multiplication uses leading count F=2 n³ when multiply-add counts as 2 FLOP; this differs from issued instructions. Synthetic n=64 versus 128, using leading-term counts with fixed FP64 and algorithm. Nominal 2*64**3 = 524288 FLOP; changed 2*128**3 = 4194304 FLOP. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Simplified throughput R=lanes×FLOP/lane×vectors/cycle×GHz, an ideal arithmetic bound only. FP64 eight lanes, FMA 2 FLOP/lane, one vector/cycle; effective 3.0 versus 2.4 GHz. Nominal 8*2*1*3 = 48 GFLOP/s/core ideal; changed 8*2*1*2.4 = 38.4 GFLOP/s/core ideal. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
